decks.name: Session 0
decks.description: Build the party's shared history, hometown, relationships, and reason for beginning the campaign together.
facilitatorNotes: The GM selects only the first player for each card.
Players pass the spotlight according to each card's instructions.
The GM may skip or replace a card that does not fit the emerging story.
Pause briefly between phases to summarize what has been established.

phases.name: Who We Are
phases.description: Establish how the characters are known and how they see one another.

phases.name: Shared Past
phases.description: Create memories, secrets, debts, and stories the characters already share.

phases.name: Our Home
phases.description: Define the places, people, customs, and institutions that make the community feel real.

phases.name: What Binds Us
phases.description: Strengthen the relationships, obligations, and unresolved tensions within the group.

phases.name: What Is Changing
phases.description: Introduce a recent pressure, opportunity, or disruption that makes the present different from the past.

phases.name: Why We Leave
phases.description: Create the immediate reason the characters step into the campaign together.

completion.summaryPrompt: Summarize the party's shared history, their home, the people and places that matter to them, the tensions left unresolved, and the event that begins the campaign.
